character.name: Idle
character.prompt:
Pixel art character sprite of an original Mega-level Cyber-Abyssal Leviathan Knight named "Krakenmon", imposing hovering combat stance, three-quarter front view.

Visual Design:
- Body & Build: Massive humanoid armored sea-serpent titan with deep navy-blue and iridescent teal scaled skin across visible torso and joints.
- Armor & Plating: Heavy gunmetal-black and dark obsidian Chrome Digizoid plate armor with glowing bioluminescent neon-cyan runic circuits and gold anchor trims.
- Head & Visor: Brutal deep-sea diving battle helm with jagged dorsal fin crests, three glowing yellow optical sensors arranged triangularly, and armored pressure-release gills venting cold steam.
- Back Appendages & Thrusters: Four massive cybernetic mechanical kraken tentacles extending from the back harness, equipped with glowing cyan suction-cup laser emitters and drill-tipped metallic ends.
- Arms & Weaponry: Massive right-arm hydro-drill gauntlet with spinning silver blades; left forearm mounted with a heavy nautical crest tower shield emitting a translucent blue holographic barrier.
- Lower Body: Articulated segmented tail greaves with mechanical fin stabilizers hovering slightly above the ground.

Style Specifications:
- 32-bit crisp RPG pixel art sprite, 64x64 or 128x128 canvas resolution.
- High-contrast metallic shading, glowing bioluminescent aqua VFX, crisp dark pixel contours.
- Centered full-body sprite isolated on a clean transparent background.
